name: portrait
description: above the mantel hangs a portrait of augustus blackwood — a stern man with cold, calculating eyes. the nameplate reads 'augustus blackwood, 1835-1891'. but the paint seems... fresher than 130 years old.

params.success_message: as you study the portrait, you notice the eyes are painted with an unsettling attention to detail. they seem to follow you. but more importantly — there's a faint line around the frame. it's a door. the portrait is a door.
